title: Share request data
summary: Fiber: Share request data. Change the school name.
introduction: Locals stores a value for the current request. A middleware can set it before a route reads it.

blocks.text: Run go mod init school and go get github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2@v2.52.5 in a practice folder. Save one example as main.go and run go run . Use http://127.0.0.1:3000.

blocks.title: Share request data
blocks.code:
package main
import "github.com/gofiber/fiber/v2"
func main() {
app := fiber.New()
app.Use(func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { c.Locals("school", "Oak School"); return c.Next() })
app.Get("/school", func(c *fiber.Ctx) error { return c.SendString(c.Locals("school").(string)) })
app.Listen("127.0.0.1:3000")
}

blocks.text: The middleware stores a per-request local and calls Next. The route reads it as a string.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check a value type if it may come from a different source.
